acceptance_requirements: one continuous transient contains all four retained-bit cycles
each redistribution begins only after the preceding decision is latched
comparator input switches are off during redistribution
the physical DAC top plate is measured before comparator kickback at every cycle
all five representative conversions complete with four measured decisions
the same topology and calibration map are used for every cycle
no ideal numerical DAC threshold is injected into the comparator
cycle-to-cycle state is reset only between conversions, not between bits

claim_boundary.allowed: acceptance contract for a continuous four-cycle physical Sky130 SAR deck
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not claim that the continuous deck has been implemented, simulated, extracted, or accepted
